verdict.rationale: The only accessibility evidence is a support-page entry for turning on Live Captions, a built-in Windows accessibility tool, so the capability is partly documented. Nothing in the pack covers a built-in screen reader or accessibility options during setup or onboarding. Missing for 10: documented built-in screen reader, accessibility tools available during OS setup/getting started, broader accessibility feature documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use built-in screen readers and accessibility tools to get started with the OS
